paragraphs.text: The Suido River flows through southern Madara .

The Suido originates from the Gitte-Yatay Mountains and splits up into three streams after it flows past the Imperial Shrine . One of these streams used to flow in the northwest, past Dark's Keep , before it was destroyed. A second branch flows southwest and then past Sekana . The third stream flows due south.
During the Madara-Edemi War , the Suido was dammed following the Meteor Hammer spell. It is unknown if its original course has been restored since, or if it now flows through a different path.
